pages.title: About the Team
pages.summary: PCSS II Robotics is a student-centered STEM program at Pioneer Charter School of Science II in Saugus, Massachusetts.

sections.title: We make engineering feel reachable.
sections.body: The team is built around a simple belief: students learn deepest when they are trusted with meaningful work. Robotics combines math, science, writing, design, code, public speaking, and teamwork into one shared challenge.

items.title: Safety before speed
items.body: Every build decision starts with protecting people and equipment.

items.title: Gracious professionalism
items.body: We compete hard while helping other teams get stronger.

items.title: Document the work
items.body: Students record decisions so the next teammate can learn faster.

items.title: Everyone contributes
items.body: Mechanical, software, strategy, media, business, and outreach all matter.
